phase3.states: PR #156 RQ1 archived states: A/B/C/D x rep 1..8 x K 4,5 x start 1,2 at checkpoints 8,16,24,32,48,64
phase3.chain_start: archived theta_c and archived last draw Z_c (exactly the state the next E-step starts from)

phase4.why: Phase 3 holds theta fixed and therefore cannot show whether a larger E-step sample size changes the estimates themselves (the MCEM fixed point / slack).  Decided before any Phase 3 result.
phase4.model_seed: same as PR #156 (hist.model_seed(5, 75, rep, k, s))
phase4.probe_at_32: one-step replicates R=8 with the fit's own L; evaluation draws 16 chains x 5 with default_rng([7710000, fit_id, 32, r])
phase4.comparison: L=5 = PR #156 archived state of the same data/K/start/seed at checkpoint 32 (Phase 3 probe)
phase4.fallback: if the gate projection for Phase 4 exceeds 4 h wall clock with 4 processes, drop L=20 (keep L=50)

definitions.G: F F^T (d x d), rotation invariant
definitions.one_step_replicate: theta' = M-step(E-step chain of length L from (theta_c, Z_c)); g_r = rel_change(G'_r, G_c)
definitions.drift_noise_decomposition: m = mean_r G'_r; s2 = sum_r ||G'_r - m||^2/(R-1); drift2 = max(||m - G_c||^2 - s2/R, 0); drift_share = drift2/(drift2 + s2); same for w0, w (scalars)
definitions.eta_diag_runner: eta_x = Z_last F^T, eta_y = w0 + w z_i^T z_j on the train dyads (the PR #156 diagnostic)
definitions.eta_single_draw_noise: theta fixed at theta_c: rel_change(Z_a F^T, Z_b F^T) for the last draws of independent chains (pairs (0,1),(2,3),...,(14,15)); same for eta_y
definitions.eta_posterior_mean: eta_x_pm = Zbar F^T with Zbar the mean of the 80 fixed-theta draws (= E[eta_x] estimate, linear); eta_y_pm = mean over draws of w0 + w z_i^T z_j (NOT the plug-in w0 + w Zbar_i^T Zbar_j, which is also reported)
definitions.eta_mode: Laplace joint mode Z_hat(theta) from lk.laplace_log_observed initialised at Z_c; eta_x_mode = Z_hat F^T
definitions.slack: S(4->5) = mean over starts of C(4) - C(5); for L=5 the r-th chains of all four fits are paired

rules.R1_one_step_decomposition: per fit at checkpoint 64: drift_share <= 0.2 -> ONE_STEP_NOISE_DOMINATED; >= 0.5 -> ONE_STEP_SYSTEMATIC_DOMINATED; else MIXED (G, w0, w). The systematic one-step component includes mean reversion of a fluctuating state and is NOT by itself evidence of long-run drift (long-run movement is judged only by R5)
rules.R1b_mean_reversion: cosine between (mean one-step G' - G_c) and (center - G_c), center = mean of G at the other checkpoints among 16,24,32,48,64; same sign check for w0 and w (descriptive)
rules.R2_observed_vs_fixed_theta: ratio = median observed PR#156 diagnostic over iterations 57..64 / median of the 16 one-step replicate values at checkpoint 64; 0.67 <= ratio <= 1.5 -> CONSISTENT_WITH_ONE_STEP_NOISE, > 1.5 -> EXCESS_MOVEMENT, < 0.67 -> LESS_THAN_ONE_STEP (gram, eta_x, eta_y)
rules.R3_eta_diagnostic: share = median single-draw eta noise at theta_64 / median observed eta diagnostic over 57..64; >= 0.8 -> ETA_DIAGNOSTIC_SAMPLING_DOMINATED (x and y separately)
rules.R4_posterior_mean_change: ratio = rel_change(eta_pm(64), eta_pm(32)) / sqrt(e32^2 + e64^2); > 2 -> PARAMETER_CHANGE_DETECTED
rules.R5_systematic_movement: per quantity Q in {G, w0, w, eta_x_mode, eta_y_mode}: D(c) = rel_change(Q_64, Q_c). Count fits with D(16) > D(48); SYSTEMATIC_MOVEMENT if two-sided exact binomial p < 0.01 with proportion > 0.5 AND median D(16)/D(48) > 1.1; otherwise NO_DETECTABLE_SYSTEMATIC_MOVEMENT. Fits share datasets (32 datasets) -- reported as a caveat, rule not changed
rules.R6_effect_with_better_evaluation: paired B-A, C-A, D-A of the L=80 fixed-theta slack at 32 and 64: MAINTAINED if median > 0 and >= 6/8 positive; NOT_MAINTAINED if median <= 0; else INCONCLUSIVE
rules.R7_slack_mc_noise: sd of the L=5 fixed-theta slack (16 paired values) vs PR #156 |S_fit(64) - S_fit(48)| (descriptive)
rules.R8_phase4: descriptive pilot, no confirmatory verdict. Prediction (DERIVED, MC scaling): plateau gram_rel_change ~ 1/sqrt(L) (ratio L50/L5 ~ 0.32); eta single-draw diagnostic does not shrink with L. Slack: L_CHANGES_SLACK only if all 4 reps move in the same direction by more than 2 x the combined L=80 MC se; else NO_CLEAR_L_EFFECT

failure_rules: exceptions / non-finite draws -> FAILED row, no retry, no reseed; Laplace not OK -> C_Lap / mode quantities INCOMPLETE, no imputation
